avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and CYP2E1, increasing acetaminophen metabolism and toxic metabolite (NAPQI) formation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; increases hepatotoxicity risk

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxic supplement that compounds acetaminophen-related liver injury risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use together due to cumulative hepatotoxicity

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin A (>10,000 IU daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both are hepatotoxic; combined use increases risk of liver damage
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid chronic concurrent use; monitor liver function if necessary

caution_supplements.name: N-acetylcysteine (NAC)
caution_supplements.mechanism: NAC is used to treat acetaminophen overdose but may theoretically interfere with therapeutic effect at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use at therapeutic doses only; monitor if combining

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: May provide hepatoprotective effects; minor CYP3A4 induction possible
caution_supplements.action: Monitor; generally considered safe but may slightly increase metabolism

avoid_foods.name: Chronic alcohol consumption
avoid_foods.mechanism: Alcohol induces CYP2E1, increasing toxic metabolite formation and depleting glutathione stores; significantly increases hepatotoxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Avoid alcohol entirely or limit to <1 drink/day; risk is dose and duration dependent

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay acetaminophen absorption, slowing onset of analgesia slightly
caution_foods.action: Take on empty stomach or with light food for optimal absorption

caution_foods.name: Charbroiled foods (well-done meats)
caution_foods.mechanism: Contains compounds that may induce CYP1A2, potentially increasing acetaminophen metabolism
caution_foods.action: No strict avoidance needed; monitor if consuming in excess

monitoring_notes: Monitor liver function tests (AST, ALT, bilirubin) in patients with chronic use, pre-existing liver disease, or concurrent hepatotoxic agents. Ensure total daily acetaminophen dose from all sources does not exceed 3,000-4,000 mg/day in healthy adults to minimize hepatotoxicity risk.
